stem: In a stratospheric cycle, $\text{NO}\cdot + \text{O}_3 \rightarrow \text{NO}_2\cdot + \text{O}_2$ and $\text{NO}_2\cdot + \text{O} \rightarrow \text{NO}\cdot + \text{O}_2$. If $2.0\ \mu\text{mol}$ of $\text{NO}\cdot$ completes 500 full turnovers, how much $\text{O}_2$ is formed?

verdicts.working: Each full turnover forms 2 mol O₂ per mol NO. Thus, 2.0 μmol × 500 × 2 = 2000 μmol = 2.0 mmol O₂.

working:
Net reaction: $\text{O}_3 + \text{O} \rightarrow 2\text{O}_2$\nTurnovers $= 2.0\ \mu\text{mol} \times 500 = 1.0\ \text{mmol}$\n$n(\text{O}_2)=2 \times 1.0=2.0\ \text{mmol}$

Independent check: Each full turnover forms 2 mol O₂ per mol NO. Thus, 2.0 μmol × 500 × 2 = 2000 μmol = 2.0 mmol O₂.
solution:
Each full turnover produces $2$ mol of $\text{O}_2$ per mol of $\text{NO}\cdot$. Thus,
$$n(\text{O}_2)=2.0\ \mu\text{mol}\times 500\times 2=2000\ \mu\text{mol}=2.0\ \text{mmol}$$
